ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $O$ is a point on the line $AB$, with $\angle BOC=40^\circ$, and $OD$ bisects $\angle AOC$. What is the degree measure of $\angle AOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle BOC=40^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC=180^\circ-\angle BOC=140^\circ$,\\
since OD bisects $\angle AOC$,\\
thus $\angle AOD= \frac{1}{2} \angle AOC= \boxed{70^\circ}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a horizontal straight line AB, point O is on straight line AB, A is to the left of O, and B is to the right of O, so OA and OB are opposite rays on the same straight line. Reasoning: Because OA and OB are opposite rays, ∠AOC and ∠COB (that is, ∠BOC) form a straight angle, and their sum is 180°. It is known that ∠BOC = 40°, therefore ∠AOC = 180° - 40° = 140°.
